# Kaggle parity kernels (GENERATED by consolidation/bundle.py - do not edit)

Each kernel is a single file; attach the competition data and the kernel sources below, then read the
`PARITY ...` lines and the final `PARITY SUMMARY verdict=...` line of the log. Queue rows and path_flow must be
EXACT; state rows report max |d| and RMS (EXACT expected for the isolated stages on the same image).

| Kernel | Priority | ~min | Stages (pick, recipe) | What it checks | Kernel sources |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `tfb-par-t4` | required | 20 | t4 (A2, full) | Task 4 NNLS (tfb-final cell 7) -> skeleton; path_flow must equal tfb-final and both final files exactly | 3: tfb-final, tfb-j4, tfb-j3 |
| `tfb-par-onsetsp` | required | 10 | onset_sp (B2, full) | Task 2 onset CatBoost + same-scenario prior (tfb-t2osp): base / sp2 / sp4 / sp8 queue files exactly | 1: tfb-t2osp |
| `tfb-par-onsetpv` | required | 15 | onset_pv (A2, full) | Task 2 onset pv bag (tfb-t2opv): base / sp4 / pv / pvb exactly; base and sp4 also against tfb-t2osp | 2: tfb-t2opv, tfb-t2osp |
| `tfb-par-t1mix` | required | 15 | t1_mix (A2, full) | T1 mix + blackout override (tfb-i4d) from the 31 original member outputs; every row vs tfb-i4d | 32: tfb-i4d + 31 Task 1 member parts of the full recipe (a/b, bspec a/b/c; see the push command) |
| `tfb-par-t1recon` | required | 20 | t1_recon (A2, full) | FD recon + 1-D TV (tfb-i4) on the original tfb-i4d file; FDR / FDRTV / TV vs tfb-i4 | 2: tfb-i4d, tfb-i4 |
| `tfb-par-asma2` | required | 8 | assemble (A2, full) | queue assembly A2 (4 condition x split parts on the original tfb-i4 file) vs tfb-j4 submission_J4.csv | 6: tfb-i4, tfb-t2osp, tfb-t2occ, tfb-t2opv, tfb-t2ogpvogf, tfb-j4 |
| `tfb-par-asmb2` | required | 8 | assemble (B2, full) | queue assembly B2 (4 condition x split parts on the original tfb-i4 file) vs tfb-j3 submission_J3.csv | 5: tfb-i4, tfb-t2osp, tfb-t2occ, tfb-t2ogveto, tfb-j3 |
| `tfb-par-chaint1` | integration | 45 | t4, t1_mix, t1_recon (A2, full) | production wiring of the Task 1 / Task 4 rows: t4 skeleton -> t1_mix -> t1_recon; state + path_flow vs tfb-j4 | 32: tfb-j4 + 31 Task 1 member parts of the full recipe (a/b, bspec a/b/c; see the push command) |
| `tfb-par-chaint2a2` | integration | 30 | onset_sp, onset_pv, assemble (A2, full) | A2 queue rows with the onset stages rerun (ongoing rows from the original producers) vs tfb-j4, every row | 4: tfb-i4, tfb-t2occ, tfb-t2ogpvogf, tfb-j4 |
| `tfb-par-chaint2b2` | integration | 20 | onset_sp, assemble (B2, full) | B2 queue rows with the onset stage rerun (ongoing rows from the original producers) vs tfb-j3, every row | 4: tfb-i4, tfb-t2occ, tfb-t2ogveto, tfb-j3 |
| `tfb-par-lean1` | optional | 30 | t1_mix, t1_recon (A2, lean1) | DESIGN 3.3 decision data: lean-1 mix (19 member outputs) + recon/TV; state RMS vs the full-recipe tfb-i4d / tfb-i4 (DIFF expected) | 21: tfb-i4d, tfb-i4 + 19 Task 1 member parts of the lean1 recipe (a/b, bspec a/b/c; see the push command) |
